verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own mute/ignore controls: errors can be snoozed or ignored, dashboard discard rules can be synced to SDKs, and there is a quota-overage rate-limiting option. That covers the ignore/mute part of the story and loosely touches spike handling, but nothing ties these controls to alert or page suppression. missing for 10: explicit spike protection, per-key or per-project rate limits, alert/notification throttling rules that stop paging during a bad deploy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can fight alert fatigue with spike protection, per-key rate limits, and mute/ignore rules so one bad deploy doesn't page the whole team all night

citations.quote: All errors except those that are fixed, snoozed or ignored
Remote SDK Source-Side Discard Enforcement now syncs active dashboard discard rules directly to upgraded Android and iOS SDKs
We provide two options for handling daily event quota overages, _capture every event_ and _rate limiting_.
